newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian anti-Mafia commission elects new head.
newsitem.headline: Italian anti-Mafia commission elects new head.

text.p: The anti-Mafia commission of the Italian parliament elected pro-government politician Ottaviano Del Turco as its new chairman on Wednesday after the position had been vacant for almost eight months.

Del Turco, a member of Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini's centrist Italian Renewal party, won 30 votes from the all-party commission, made up of 50 members of both houses of parliament, in an election in which he was unopposed.
The commission is one of the most important in parliament, with powers similar to those of magistrates to summon witnesses for its investigations into organised crime.
The chair had been vacant since the new parliament convened in May because of a failure among parties in the governing centre-left Olive Tree alliance to agree on a candidate.
The deadlock was broken only on Wednesday morning when parliamentary party leaders rallied around Del Turco, a former trades unionist who is a member of the upper Senate.
Tiziana Parenti, a former magistrate from the opposition centre-right Freedom Alliance, chaired the commission in the last parliament.
